title: Cloud and AWS fundamentals
intro: Before VPCs and IAM policies, you need the vocabulary every AWS answer builds on: what cloud computing delivers, who owns security, how control and data planes differ, which service category solves which problem, and how billing and quotas work.

overviewDiagram.title: Foundation concepts flow
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  CC[Cloud computing] --> SRM[Shared responsibility]
  SRM --> CP[Control vs data plane]
  CP --> MAP[Service map]
  MAP --> BILL[Billing and quotas]

conceptCards.title: Cloud computing
conceptCards.summary: Metered IT resources over the network — IaaS, PaaS, SaaS with Regions and Availability Zones.
conceptCards.example: EC2 is IaaS; Lambda is PaaS-style compute.

conceptCards.title: Shared responsibility
conceptCards.summary: AWS secures the cloud; you secure configuration, IAM, network rules, and data.
conceptCards.example: You enable S3 Block Public Access — AWS does not do it for you.

conceptCards.title: Control vs data plane
conceptCards.summary: Management APIs configure resources; data plane serves user and application traffic.

conceptCards.title: Service map
conceptCards.summary: Compute, storage, networking, database, security, integration — pick category first.

conceptCards.title: Billing and quotas
conceptCards.summary: Pay per use; tag for attribution; quotas cap provisioning per Region.
conceptCards.example: NAT Gateway hours and egress are common surprise costs.
